x: Four Belgravians turned out with Carl Lawton doing his second fastest ever 10 km for 4th behind the winner Roger Mills. Len Duquemin was an easy 7th but Ray Middleton and Allan Callow never got to grips with the dusty track surface and slow start, Carl lapped them both.

And amongst others present, Roger Mills, whose heroic efforts in reaching the finishing line at the Rome European Games after a punishing 20 kilometres were witnessed by millions on TV, and were rewarded eventually with the silver medal.

They are in good company, our own champion, Carl, could claim a place in our cross country or road relay teams by virtue of his running performances. Other top class walkers who also take part in running events include Brian Adams, Christine Coleman, Judy Farr and Roger Mills.

After five kilos Olly Flynn, Roger Mills and Brian Adams were away battling for Individual honours and they finished in that order. Then came the leading group which contained Carl and Graham, Ray soon appeared but where was our fourth man?

To round off the weekend nicely, at Crystal Palace in the Debenham International, Graham Seatter had another crack at Roger Mills over 1 mile and came within two seconds of beating him - 6:18 to 6:20.

Anna and Jane were in action again the following day, 27th November, placing 5th and 9th in Havering AC's ladies open 3Km with 16:47 and 18:41. Carl Lawton was also on the road again, this time winning the men's 10Km from the redoubtable Roger Mills - 45:38 to 46:07.
